dag.description: XGBoost complete end-to-end pipeline for a tabular abuse-risk model (e.g. Active Queueing MFN/PFW manual-review queueing). Trains XGBoost, percentile-calibrates scores on a calibration split, and additionally scores a separate held-out testing split whose metrics are published to PIPER for model monitoring. Package consumes the percentile-calibrated model; the testing branch is metrics-only and does not feed Package/Registration.

agent_context.when_to_use: XGBoost tabular risk model (e.g. Active Queueing MFN/PFW manual-review queueing) that trains and percentile-calibrates on a calibration split AND evaluates a separate held-out testing split whose metrics are published to PIPER for monitoring/dashboards. Use when your team consumes model-quality metrics through PIPER rather than a generated model wiki.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you publish metrics as a model wiki instead of PIPER (use xgboost_complete_e2e_with_calibration_and_testing). If you have no separate held-out testing split (use xgboost_percentile_e2e). If you need sigmoid/isotonic ModelCalibration instead of percentile bucketing.
differentiators: Testing branch terminates in PiperMetricGeneration_testing (metrics to PIPER) instead of ModelMetricsComputation_testing + ModelWikiGenerator
First catalog pattern to use the PiperMetricGeneration step
Three data branches: training, calibration (percentile), and held-out testing (PIPER metrics)
Package consumes the PercentileModelCalibration output; the testing branch is metrics-only

prerequisites.check: Separate training, calibration, and testing Cradle SQL / dataset splits
prerequisites.how: three Cradle SQL blocks (or three job_type splits)
PiperMetricGeneration step config points at a valid PIPER metric namespace

common_pitfalls: Testing branch does not feed Package/Registration - it only emits metrics
PercentileModelCalibration output (not raw XGBoostTraining) is what Package registers
PiperMetricGeneration_testing consumes the XGBoostModelInference_testing scored output
